title: Unit – 5 : Session – 7 : SLO – 2  |  Event Loops, Event Sources and Handlers
sections: 1. Event loop — the central infinite loop (e.g. Tkinter's mainloop()) that continuously waits for events, dequeues them and dispatches each to its registered handler.
2. Event source — the object that generates events, e.g. a button being clicked, a key being pressed, a timer expiring, or a socket receiving data.
3. Event handler — the function/method registered to run in response to a specific event from a source, e.g. the callback executed when a button is clicked.
Event source raises event → event loop catches it → matching event handler executes → control returns to the loop.
